content: <thought>After checking the initial list, several reagents (TBDMSCl, Imidazole, TBAF, TEMPO) were not commercially available in the catalog. I replaced the protecting group strategy with an acetyl protection (using acetyl chloride, which is buyable) and a simple base (pyridine) for the acylation. Deprotection can be achieved by saponification with aqueous NaOH (buyable). Oxidation of the terminal alcohol to the carboxylic acid can be performed directly with NaClO (bleach), which is also buyable. All leaf compounds are now commercially available, and the total cost will be well under $10 000. The revised five‑step retrosynthetic route is presented below.
